Callout.Name: Choking
Callout.Message: Person choking, still conscious, airway partly clear.
Callout.Advisory: Restaurant staff on scene, patient distressed.

Script.Line: It was a piece of steak. It went down the wrong way.
I put my hands up and somebody did the thing. Somebody did it properly.
I have never been that frightened. That is not an exaggeration.

Callout.Patient: (coughing) It is out. It is out.

Lines.Approach: Still conscious and still choking. Whatever they ate, nobody has got it out yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
